gizmo.title: Kālailai heluhelu
gizmo.description: Kau nā haumāna i nā hae ma nā māmalaʻōlelo, nā paukū a i ʻole nā kiʻi o ka heluhelu he hōʻike no kēlā me kēia lepili, a i ʻole koho lākou i ka paukū e pane maikaʻi loa ana i kekahi nīnau.

configure.title: Nīnau
configure.description: Ka mea e noi ʻia ai nā haumāna e loaʻa i ka heluhelu.

configure.title: Hana
configure.description: Hae i nā hōʻike: hoʻopili nā haumāna i kēlā me kēia hae ma ka ʻaoʻao o kona hōʻike. Koho i hoʻokahi: koho nā haumāna i ka paukū hoʻokahi e pane maikaʻi loa ana i ka nīnau.

configure.title: Koho nā haumāna
configure.description: Ka mea a ka haumāna e kuhikuhi ai ma ka heluhelu. Hiki ke koho mau ʻia nā kiʻi.

configure.title: Hae
configure.description: Nā lepili a nā haumāna e kau ai. E hoʻohana iā Kaha i nā pane ma ka papa koho o ka poloka e koho ai i ka wahi o kēlā me kēia.

configure.title: Heluhelu
configure.description: Ka heluhelu a nā haumāna e hana ai. Kekahi HTML: nā poʻomanaʻo, nā paukū, nā papa helu a me nā kiʻi.

configure.title: ʻAno helu kaha
configure.description: OER Schema: ke ʻano helu kaha no kēia loiloi (e laʻa me nā kiko, ka hua, ka pākēneka, ka hoʻopau).

configure.title: Pahuhopu aʻo
configure.description: OER Schema: ka pahuhopu aʻo e pili ana i kēia loiloi.

configure.title: Papa
configure.description: OER Schema: ka papa i manaʻo ʻia ai kēia loiloi.

advanced.title: Nā hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: ʻEhia manawa e hiki ai i ka haumāna ke nānā. ʻO 0 ka manaʻo palena ʻole.

advanced.title: Hiki ke hōʻuku
advanced.description: E hōʻike i kēia nīnau ma ke ʻano lālani e wehe ʻia a pani ʻia. ʻO ka wehe ʻana i kekahi, pani ia i nā nīnau hōʻuku ʻē aʻe ma ka ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: E hoʻomaka me ka hōʻuku ʻia
advanced.description: I ka wā hiki ke hōʻuku, hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano lālani pani ʻia e hōʻike ana i ka nīnau a me kona kūlana wale nō.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hōʻike
developer.description: Inoa hōʻike i hoʻouna ʻia no ka hoʻohana ʻana ma nā kaiapuni xAPI no ka ʻike ʻana i kēia mea
